speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what in-school programmes are currently in place to educate children enrolled in primary schools about how to recognise and report physical, sexual and emotional abuses in school settings; and (b) how will the Ministry evaluate the effectiveness of these programmes.

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim (Nominated Member)
text: I think my question here is: apart from MOE's sexuality education curriculum, is there anything else that we are doing to ensure that we create a safe and supportive environment, where children are empowered to speak up about concerns that they have?

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim (Nominated Member)
text: My second question is: what are we doing, in terms of providing training and resources for teachers to effectively address this situation and not to also be the perpetrator, the one that causes such harm in a school setting?

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: Because we know that sometimes, students are afraid to speak to their parents about bullying or the abuse that they experience.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: So, we tell our students that they should look out for one another and also, be able to confide in their friends around them.
